t.len -> Int
  where t: Text
xs.len -> Int
  where xs: List[T]
docs: Built in on `Text` and `List` and, from edition 0.2 on, on `Map` (`spec/14 §2`,
`spec/21 §2`). On a `Text` it counts Unicode scalar values (`spec/14 §1`); a map's is
never negative (`spec/21 §2`).

variants.declaration:
m.has(key: K) -> Bool
  where m: Map[K, V]
docs: Whether `m` has `key`. Like `m.len`, it may appear in `requires`, `ensures`, `where`
and predicates (`spec/21 §2`, `spec/21 §4`).

variants.declaration:
m.get(key: K) -> Option[V]
  where m: Map[K, V]
docs: `Some` exactly when `m.has(key: k)`. A missing key gives `None`, not a failure

variants.declaration:
edit m.set(key: K, value: V) -> Unit
  where m: Map[K, V]
docs: Updates `m` in place, written `edit m.set(...)`: afterwards `m.has(key: k)` and
`m.get(key: k) == Some(v)`, and `m.len` grows by one when the key was not there

variants.declaration:
edit m.remove(key: K) -> Unit
  where m: Map[K, V]
docs: Updates `m` in place, written `edit m.remove(...)`: afterwards `not m.has(key: k)`,
and `m.len` shrinks by one when the key was there (`spec/21 §2`).

variants.declaration:
m.with(key: K, value: V) -> Map[K, V]
  where m: Map[K, V]
docs: A map with the contract of `set`, for the result (`spec/21 §2`).

variants.declaration:
m.without(key: K) -> Map[K, V]

docs: A map with the contract of `remove`, for the result (`spec/21 §2`).

variants.declaration:

variants.declaration:

docs: The entries of `m` as `Entry` values, in key order, as many as `m.len`

variants.declaration:
edit m.update(key: K, initial: V, change: fn(V) -> V) -> Unit
  where m: Map[K, V]
docs: Updates `m` in place, written `edit m.update(...)`: sets `key` to `change(v)`, where
`v` is its value, or `initial` when `m` has no `key`. `change` is called exactly once,
and when it fails, `m` keeps its value from before the call (`spec/21 §2`).

variants.declaration:
edit s.push(item: T) -> Unit
  where s: Stack[T]
edit q.push(item: T) -> Unit
  where q: Queue[T]
docs: Updates the receiver in place, written `edit s.push(item: x)`: a `Stack` takes
`item` on top and a `Queue` at its back, and its length grows by one, in O(1)
amortized time (`spec/28 §5`).

variants.declaration:
edit s.pop() -> Option[T]
  where s: Stack[T]
edit q.pop() -> Option[T]
  where q: Queue[T]
docs: Updates the receiver in place, written `let x = edit s.pop()`: it removes the top of
a `Stack` or the front of a `Queue` and gives it as `Some`, or gives `None` and
leaves an empty one as it is, in O(1) amortized time (`spec/28 §5`).

variants.declaration:
s.peek() -> Option[T]
  where s: Stack[T]
q.peek() -> Option[T]
  where q: Queue[T]
docs: The top of a `Stack` or the front of a `Queue`, the item `pop` would remove, as
`Some`, and `None` exactly when it is empty, in O(1) time (`spec/28 §5`).

variants.declaration:
s.items() -> List[T]
  where s: Stack[T]
q.items() -> List[T]
  where q: Queue[T]
docs: The items as a list, a `Stack` top first and a `Queue` front first, as many as its
`len`, in O(n) time (`spec/28 §5`).

variants.declaration:
edit q.push_front(item: T) -> Unit
  where q: Queue[T]
docs: Updates a `Queue` in place, written `edit q.push_front(item: x)`: `item` goes to the
front, so `peek` gives it, in O(1) amortized time (`spec/28 §5`).

variants.declaration:
edit q.pop_back() -> Option[T]
  where q: Queue[T]
docs: Updates a `Queue` in place, written `let x = edit q.pop_back()`: it removes the back
and gives it as `Some`, or gives `None` when the queue is empty, in O(1) amortized
time (`spec/28 §5`).

variants.declaration:
q.peek_back() -> Option[T]
  where q: Queue[T]
docs: The back of a `Queue`, the item `pop_back` would remove, as `Some`, and `None`
exactly when it is empty, in O(1) time (`spec/28 §5`).

variants.declaration:
a.shift_right(by: Int) -> F
  where a: F, one of I8, I16, I32, I64, U8, U16, U32, U64
docs: Requires `0 <= by` and `by` below the width; on an unsigned type the result is at
most `a`. On a signed type it divides by `2^by`, rounding toward negative infinity

variants.declaration:
a.wrapping_shift_left(by: Int) -> F
  where a: F, one of I8, I16, I32, I64, U8, U16, U32, U64
docs: Requires `0 <= by` and `by` below the width: `a * 2^by` reduced into the type's
range modulo `2^w`. There is no checked left shift (`spec/18 §5`).
